sst.name: EOCIS Sea Surface Temperature
sst.description:
This dataset provides daily estimates of global sea surface temperature (SST) based on observations from multiple satellite sensors.

Resolution: 5km.

.Available from 1980 to current.

lst_s3a_day.name: EOCIS Daytime Land Surface Temperatures - Sentinel3A
lst_s3a_day.description: This dataset provides EOCIS land surface temperature daytime data. Resolution: 5km.

lst_s3b_day.name: EOCIS Daytime Land Surface Temperatures - Sentinel3B
lst_s3b_day.description: This dataset provides EOCIS land surface temperature daytime data.  Resolution: 5km.

lst_s3a_night.name: EOCIS Nightime Land Surface Temperatures - Sentinel3A
lst_s3a_night.description: This dataset provides EOCIS land surface temperature nighttime data.  Resolution: 5km.

lst_s3b_night.name: EOCIS Nighttime Land Surface Temperatures - Sentinel3B
lst_s3b_night.description: This dataset provides EOCIS land surface temperature nighttime data.  Resolution: 5km.

aerosol_slstr_daily_s3a.name: AEROSOL observations daily - Sentinel 3A
aerosol_slstr_daily_s3a.description: This dataset contains the level-3 daily mean aerosol properties products from Sentinel-3A SLSTR satellite observations. Data are processed using the Swansea University algorithm

aerosol_slstr_daily_s3b.name: EOCIS AEROSOL observations daily - Sentinel 3B
aerosol_slstr_daily_s3b.description: This dataset contains the level-3 daily mean aerosol properties products from Sentinel-3B SLSTR satellite observations. Data are processed using the Swansea University algorithm

aerosol_slstr_monthly_s3a.name: EOCIS AEROSOL observations monthly - Sentinel 3A
aerosol_slstr_monthly_s3a.description: This dataset contains the level-3 monthly mean aerosol properties products from Sentinel-3A SLSTR satellite observations. Data are processed using the Swansea University algorithm

aerosol_slstr_monthly_s3b.name: EOCIS AEROSOL observations monthly - Sentinel 3B
aerosol_slstr_monthly_s3b.description: This dataset contains the level-3 monthly mean aerosol properties products from Sentinel-3B SLSTR satellite observations. Data are processed using the Swansea University algorithm
